description: Defines a default port on a diagram stencil.

members.name: IsInput
members.description: Whether the port accepts incoming edges.

members.name: IsOutput
members.description: Whether the port allows outgoing edges.

members.name: MagnetStrategy
members.description: Magnet strategy for edge snapping. Supported: cardinal, perimeter, custom.

members.name: Offset
members.description: Offset along the side as a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0.

members.name: Side
members.description: Which side of the node the port sits on.
